dogecoin.text: Lent Elon my time machine in 2008 so he could see Mars. He came back with a DogeCoin wallet and a 7-hour loop of Joe Rogan laughing. Air still tastes like vape.
Tried shouting “LFG” at the Oracle of Delphi in 344 BC. She collapsed into a trance, predicted Dogecoin, and bled obsidian from her eyes. Town blamed me. Typical Tuesday.
